title: Add a close-gated native updater lifecycle
summary: Implement an explicit native updater state machine that separates signed update discovery/download from operator-confirmed, backend-close-gated installation.
reason: Remediate AUDIT-FIND-W09-007: the updater plug-in is registered and signed artifacts are published, but installed clients have no executable check, prompt, download, safe shutdown, install, restart, or recovery flow.
behavior_before: The shell registered the updater plug-in without any consumer path, while active documentation claimed prompted close-gated updates.
behavior_after: Productized shells check the signed channel on startup, separate verified download from explicit install confirmation, fail closed on fresh close-readiness or safe-only shutdown failure, retain bounded native recovery evidence, and reconcile installer handoff against the exact version observed on the next launch. The packet remains in progress pending signed clean-account acceptance.
manual_validation: Tauri prerequisites passed; 26 PG-1 close-readiness scaffold tests passed; 74 Rust tests passed; 100 Tauri scaffold tests passed

candidate manifest comparison: 17 packet-owned packaged paths matched source and manifest SHA-256, including updater controller, its generated summary, and Tauri scaffold test; 3 status/change-evidence paths were policy-omitted; 5 generated change/index paths changed only after post-build packet finalization
cargo check --all-targets; cargo test updater_controller - 6 passed
cargo fmt passed; Ruff passed; Clippy passed with only exact pre-existing while-let-loop/io-other-error warnings allowed

full release self-test: updater-specific release-content policy failure corrected; focused package policy then passed; remaining failures are established global freshness, dependency, Ruff, WebView, and status baselines
generated-context guard selection: 37 tests plus 61 subtests passed; lifecycle map, project index, feature map, risky registry, architecture, naming, and test inventory passed
strict validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage passed with 1,183 valid packets
rollback_plan: Revert the native updater controller, native dialogs, lifecycle evidence, focused tests, documentation, generated outputs, and packet metadata together; retain signed artifact generation and the existing manual-install fallback.
notes:
High-risk binary-update and close-readiness boundary.
